calculation_handling.description: Lists the uses permitted in the RM zone subject to the conditions in Clause 10.80.20.100, including garden suites, laneway suites and secondary suites.
calculation_handling.gaps: Most listed uses (institutional, care, commercial, utility) are outside the MaxBLD building types and are not assessed; the bracketed numbers are references to the conditions in 10.80.20.100.

10.80.20.20(1).explanation: In the RM zone a list of uses, including garden suites, laneway suites and secondary suites, is permitted only if each meets its matching condition in Clause 10.80.20.100.
